Dental Practice Analytics

Know What's Actually Driving Your Practice's Revenue

Scape connects to your practice management software and turns years of appointment, billing, and patient data into a live dashboard — so you can see recall gaps, no-show risk, and revenue leakage before they show up on your P&L.

Book a Free Demo

Sound familiar?

Revenue looks fine most months, but you can't tell why some months underperform.

No-shows and cancellations eat into chair time and nobody catches the pattern until it's a habit.

Recall patients quietly stop coming back and no one notices until they've been gone a year.

Every KPI lives in a different report, or in someone's head.

What we track for you

Built directly from your existing systems — no new software for your staff to learn.

No-show rate

Track and predict which upcoming appointments are at risk.

Patient retention

See exactly which recall patients are overdue, and for how long.

Case acceptance rate

Understand which treatment plans convert and which stall.

Chair utilization

Spot underused operatory hours before they become a scheduling problem.

Production per provider

Compare performance across hygienists and dentists fairly.

Collections ratio

Catch insurance and billing leakage before it compounds.

How it works

1

Connect

We securely connect to your practice management system (Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, and others) — no manual exports required.

2

Build

We build a dashboard around the metrics that matter for your practice specifically, not a generic template.

3

Predict

AI models flag which patients are likely to no-show or churn, so your front desk knows exactly who to call.

4

Act

You get a weekly view your whole team can act on, not a report that sits unread.

See your practice's numbers, automatically.

Book a free walkthrough. We'll show you what your dashboard would actually look like with your data.
